description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) is hiring a Scientific Applications Software Engineer I to support NASA missions by developing cloud-based software and data systems. The role focuses on building data-processing workflows and tools, integrating and testing software, and supporting science data products.
Scientific Applications Software Engineer I developing cloud-based data processing workflows, software capabilities, tools, and services.

Responsibilities:
• Working directly with Cog-Es and development leads to design/develop new capabilities, fix bugs, and document systems
• Developing data processing workflows and software related to data products
• Designing, developing, integrating, and testing software capabilities in compliance with interface and requirements documents
• Developing software on the cloud using open-source tools – e.g., Elasticsearch, Conda, Terraform, Apache HTTP Server (web server), Python Flask, AWS CLI (AWS command line utility) etc
• Developing new tools and services and contributing to their design based on the use cases defined

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Mathematics with a minimum of 1 year of related work experience; or a Master's in a similar discipline with 0 years of related work experience
• Knowledge of software development discipline Including software development lifecycle, requirement development, verification & validation, Configuration Management and issue tracking
• Experience with agile development framework and sprint lifecycles, including sprint/task planning, code review, CI/CD and associated tool stacks (GitHub/GitLab, JIRA)
• Experience in scientific application programming utilizing Python
• Experience with Jenkins, Docker
• Experience with Linux, Docker container technologies, messaging protocols, REST-based interfaces
• Experience with IAC concepts and technologies such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation
• Willingness and/or passion to utilized GenAI coding tools and agents to assist in the software development process
• The Jet Propulsion Laboratory is a federal facility. Due to rules imposed by NASA, JPL will not accept applications from citizens of designated countries or those born in a designated country unless they are U.S. Citizens, Legal Permanent Residents of the U.S or have other protected status under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)

Preferred:
• Experience with AWS cloud processing, services and data storage strongly preferred; specifically, familiarity with the AWS console, EC2 instance management, S3 storage, Lambda, SNS/SQS, and concepts like Autoscaling groups and basics on how networking & security works
• Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS)
• Experience working with a team to turn prototype algorithms into delivered software products
• Experience managing software build processes in Linux environment
• Experience in data science and big data technologies
• Understanding of concepts of large-volume data processing workflows (Airflow) and management
